panels.title: Win rate
panels.description: Share of wins within each location: the first on-time delivery of an event that at least two connected providers competed for. Missing an event’s deadline loses it. Each row sums to 100%. Green = the location’s leader (ties share it), yellow ≥10%, red <10%.

targets.rawSql:
WITH (SELECT groupArray(tuple(region, cloud_provider, bucket, generation)) FROM (SELECT c.region, c.cloud_provider, c.bucket, c.generation FROM
 (SELECT region, cloud_provider, bucket, max(commits.generation) generation, argMax(commits.revision, commits.generation) revision
  FROM benchmark_rollup_commits AS commits
  WHERE bucket + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE > $__fromTime_ms AND bucket < $__toTime_ms
  AND ((bucket >= $__fromTime_ms AND bucket + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE <= $__toTime_ms) OR bucket < now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR) GROUP BY region, cloud_provider, bucket) c
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT region, cloud_provider, bucket, sum(revision) revision, sum(expected) expected, sum(incomplete) incomplete FROM benchmark_dirty_minutes
  WHERE bucket + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE > $__fromTime_ms AND bucket < $__toTime_ms
  AND ((bucket >= $__fromTime_ms AND bucket + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE <= $__toTime_ms) OR bucket < now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR) GROUP BY region, cloud_provider, bucket) d
 ON c.region = d.region AND c.cloud_provider = d.cloud_provider AND c.bucket = d.bucket
 WHERE c.revision >= d.revision AND d.revision >= d.expected AND d.incomplete = 0)) AS rollup_generations
 SELECT * FROM (SELECT * EXCEPT (region, cloud_provider),
 if(win_percent IS NULL, NULL, concat(multiIf(
   toFloat64(toDecimalString(win_percent, 1)) = max(toFloat64(toDecimalString(win_percent, 1))) OVER (PARTITION BY region, cloud_provider), 'W', toFloat64(toDecimalString(win_percent, 1)) >= 10, 'Y', 'R'),
   '|', toDecimalString(win_percent, 1))) AS win_cell
 FROM (SELECT
 concat(region, if(uniqExact(cloud_provider) OVER (PARTITION BY region) > 1, concat('/', cloud_provider), '')) AS location,
 region, cloud_provider, provider, win_percent, p50_lag_ms, p99_lag_ms, dropped_percent,
 disconnected_seconds, disconnects
 FROM (SELECT region, cloud_provider, provider, quantilesTDigestIfMerge(0.5, 0.99)(percentiles) AS qs,
 sum(wins) / nullIf(sum(sum(wins)) OVER (PARTITION BY region, cloud_provider), 0) * 100 AS win_percent,
 if(sum(delivered) > 0, qs[1] / 1e6, NULL) AS p50_lag_ms,
 if(sum(delivered) > 0, qs[2] / 1e6, NULL) AS p99_lag_ms,
 sum(missed) / nullIf(sum(delivered) + sum(missed), 0) * 100 AS dropped_percent
 FROM (SELECT * FROM benchmark_minute_rollups WHERE kind = 'provider' AND (${data_type:sqlstring} = '__all' OR data_type = ${data_type:sqlstring}) AND ((data_type = 'slot' AND commitment = 'processed')
 OR (data_type != 'slot' AND commitment = ${commitment:sqlstring}))
 AND bucket + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE > $__fromTime_ms AND bucket < $__toTime_ms
 AND (region, cloud_provider, bucket, generation) IN (SELECT tupleElement(r, 1), tupleElement(r, 2), tupleElement(r, 3), tupleElement(r, 4)
 FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(rollup_generations) AS r)) AND (region, cloud_provider, data_type, subscription_id) IN (
   SELECT region, cloud_provider, data_type,
 argMax(subscription_id, tuple(observed, last_seen, subscription_id)) AS subscription_id
 FROM (SELECT region, cloud_provider, data_type, subscription_id, last_seen, toUInt8(1) AS observed FROM (SELECT region, cloud_provider, data_type, subscription_id, last_seen
   FROM benchmark_minute_rollups WHERE kind = 'provider' AND (${data_type:sqlstring} = '__all' OR data_type = ${data_type:sqlstring}) AND ((data_type = 'slot' AND commitment = 'processed')
 OR (data_type != 'slot' AND commitment = ${commitment:sqlstring}))
 AND bucket + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE > $__fromTime_ms AND bucket < $__toTime_ms
 AND (region, cloud_provider, bucket, generation) IN (SELECT tupleElement(r, 1), tupleElement(r, 2), tupleElement(r, 3), tupleElement(r, 4)
 FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(rollup_generations) AS r)))
 UNION ALL SELECT region, cloud_provider, data_type, subscription_id, last_seen, toUInt8(0) AS observed
 FROM (SELECT region, cloud_provider, data_type, subscription_id, provider, event_utc AS last_seen
 FROM benchmark_connection_events WHERE (${data_type:sqlstring} = '__all' OR data_type = ${data_type:sqlstring}) AND ((data_type = 'slot' AND commitment = 'processed')
 OR (data_type != 'slot' AND commitment = ${commitment:sqlstring}))
 AND event_utc >= $__fromTime_ms - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND event_utc <= $__toTime_ms)) GROUP BY region, cloud_provider, data_type)) GROUP BY region, cloud_provider, provider) AS metrics
 -- Providers without recorded disconnects get zero downtime (non-Nullable defaults).
 FULL JOIN (SELECT region, cloud_provider, provider,
 sumIf(greatest(0, dateDiff('millisecond', greatest(start_utc, range_start), least(end_utc, range_end))),
   dateDiff('millisecond', start_utc, end_utc) >= 10000) / 1000 AS disconnected_seconds,
 countIf(start_utc >= range_start AND start_utc <= range_end) AS disconnects
 FROM (SELECT region, cloud_provider, provider, min(event_utc) AS start_utc, max(next_utc) AS end_utc,
  any(range_start) AS range_start, any(range_end) AS range_end
  FROM (SELECT region, cloud_provider, provider, subscription_id, event_utc,
   NOT connected AND reason NOT IN ('arrival queue full', 'control queue full') AS provider_down,
   CAST($__fromTime_ms AS DateTime64(9, 'UTC')) AS range_start,
   CAST($__toTime_ms AS DateTime64(9, 'UTC')) AS range_end,
   -- Rows of one outage share the last transition before them that was not downtime.
   maxIf(event_utc, connected OR reason IN ('arrival queue full', 'control queue full')) OVER before AS outage,
   leadInFrame(event_utc, 1, least(now64(9, 'UTC'), range_end + INTERVAL 10 SECOND)) OVER stream AS next_utc
   FROM benchmark_connection_events WHERE (${data_type:sqlstring} = '__all' OR data_type = ${data_type:sqlstring}) AND ((data_type = 'slot' AND commitment = 'processed')
 OR (data_type != 'slot' AND commitment = ${commitment:sqlstring})) AND (region, cloud_provider, data_type, subscription_id) IN (
   SELECT region, cloud_provider, data_type,
 argMax(subscription_id, tuple(observed, last_seen, subscription_id)) AS subscription_id
 FROM (SELECT region, cloud_provider, data_type, subscription_id, last_seen, toUInt8(1) AS observed FROM (SELECT region, cloud_provider, data_type, subscription_id, last_seen
   FROM benchmark_minute_rollups WHERE kind = 'provider' AND (${data_type:sqlstring} = '__all' OR data_type = ${data_type:sqlstring}) AND ((data_type = 'slot' AND commitment = 'processed')
 OR (data_type != 'slot' AND commitment = ${commitment:sqlstring}))
 AND bucket + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE > $__fromTime_ms AND bucket < $__toTime_ms
 AND (region, cloud_provider, bucket, generation) IN (SELECT tupleElement(r, 1), tupleElement(r, 2), tupleElement(r, 3), tupleElement(r, 4)
 FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(rollup_generations) AS r)))
 UNION ALL SELECT region, cloud_provider, data_type, subscription_id, last_seen, toUInt8(0) AS observed
 FROM (SELECT region, cloud_provider, data_type, subscription_id, provider, event_utc AS last_seen
 FROM benchmark_connection_events WHERE (${data_type:sqlstring} = '__all' OR data_type = ${data_type:sqlstring}) AND ((data_type = 'slot' AND commitment = 'processed')
 OR (data_type != 'slot' AND commitment = ${commitment:sqlstring}))
 AND event_utc >= $__fromTime_ms - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND event_utc <= $__toTime_ms)) GROUP BY region, cloud_provider, data_type)
   AND event_utc <= $__toTime_ms + INTERVAL 10 SECOND AND event_utc >= $__fromTime_ms - INTERVAL 1 DAY
   WINDOW stream AS (PARTITION BY region, cloud_provider, provider, subscription_id ORDER BY event_utc
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING),
   before AS (PARTITION BY region, cloud_provider, provider, subscription_id ORDER BY event_utc
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING))
  WHERE provider_down GROUP BY region, cloud_provider, provider, subscription_id, outage)
 GROUP BY region, cloud_provider, provider) AS downtime USING (region, cloud_provider, provider))
 ORDER BY provider, location)
 SETTINGS max_threads = 16, max_execution_time = 45

panels.title: p50 lag behind ideal
panels.description: Median on-time lag behind each event’s earliest provider arrival at that location. Lower is better; events that missed the deadline are excluded.

panels.title: p99 lag behind ideal
panels.description: 99th percentile on-time lag behind each event’s earliest provider arrival at that location. Lower is better; events that missed the deadline are excluded.

panels.title: Missed deadline
panels.description: Share of a connected provider’s events not delivered within the configured window after the first provider’s delivery, even if delivery arrives later.

panels.title: Downtime
panels.description: Time each provider’s streams at that location could not reconnect: outages lasting at least 10 s, from a disconnect until the next successful subscription, summed over streams. A shorter interruption, such as a rolling restart that accepts the reconnect right away, counts only as a disconnect. Disconnects caused by the subscriber’s own backlog are excluded. A stalled stream counts only from the moment it is dropped for inactivity (30 s without traffic); events in the stall count as missed deadlines.

panels.title: Disconnects
panels.description: How often each provider’s streams at that location were interrupted, including short reconnects that are not downtime. Disconnects caused by the subscriber’s own backlog are excluded.
